How this study works

All values are fictional game rules, authored 23 October 2026. No live economic or medical data is used.

Each week: stall work earns ฿15/hour; household costs ฿60. A fixed rain event in week 2 costs ฿120. Study and friendship hours accumulate without predicting intelligence or happiness.

After four weeks, replay the same month with the same rain. Compare what a different time budget changes. Progress is stored in this browser when available.

The room, street and stall retain their positions between chapters. People move with your choices. This is a rendering and interaction prototype, not an 80-year simulation.
